title: One human verification record for one test song's pseudo lead sheet

updated.description: ISO-8601 time of the last edit

complete.description: every section has label_correct and bars_correct filled

confidence.description: annotator confidence in this record (5 = certain)

correct_key.description: e.g. 'A minor', only if key_correct = no

sections.description: one entry per pseudo-label section, in order

boundary_ok.description: the section START is at the right bar

boundary_shift_bars.description: where the start should be, in bars relative to the pseudo start (+ = later)

lyric_alignment_errors.description: syllables sung on the wrong note, crammed, or placed in the wrong section

wrong_lyric_syllables.description: syllables whose TEXT is wrong or not sung at all in the recording

melody_error.description: 0 none, 1 a few notes, 2 phrase-level (octave/rhythm), 3 section unusable

corrected_sections.description: optional full human section list when sections must be merged, split, added or removed; overrides per-section corrections
